setup_password.description: Sets the password for accessing the meter setup screens.

energy_resets_password.description: Sets the password for resetting the meter’s accumulated energy values.

demand_resets_password.description: Sets the password for resetting the meter’s recorded peak demand values.

minmax_resets_password.description: Sets the password for resetting the meter’s recorded minimum and maximum values.

diagnostics_password.description: Sets the password for accessing the meter’s diagnostics screens.
